info.description: A robust API with JWT Auth and URI Versioning.

get.summary: Retrieves the details for the current authenticated user.
get.description:
This endpoint is part of the V2 transition. 
It returns a greeting message along with the identity name extracted from the JWT token.

200.description: Returns the user identity details successfully.

401.description: If the JWT token is missing, expired, or invalid.

404.description: If the user resource could not be found.

500.description: If there was an internal server error processing the request.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.
